> **Applied Platinum-Diamond UX:** Direct Manipulation 3.0, Optimistic Teleportation UX, Level 1–3 Slide Drawer Stack, Contextual Dissolving Toolbars  

## 🏗️ Architectural Overview
FleetPulse-AI is built on React 18, TypeScript 5, Vite 5, Tailwind CSS, and Lucide Icons. It incorporates 4-Tier Commercial Licensing Modals, an Ecosystem Integrations Hub for Samsara/Geotab/Slack/QuickBooks/BigQuery, and an Automated 3-Step Client State Purge & Reset Wizard.

## 📊 Core Data Schemas
- `VehicleUnit`: `{ id, vehicleName, driverName, speed, fatigueStatus, fuelLevel, dtcCode, location }`
- `DVIRChecklist`: `{ id, vehicleId, aebStatus, tirePsi, dtcCode, driverSignature, timestamp }`

## 🔒 Security & Data Compliance
- Enforces AES-256 payload encryption and NIST FIPS-203/204 Post-Quantum Cryptography standards.
- 100% FMCSA 2026 ADS & DVIR electronic logging compliance.
